final: WITH g AS (SELECT m.Name AS n, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS r, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS av FROM g WHERE c IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.r), SUM(g.c), AVG(g.c - a.av) FROM g JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE g.c > a.av
